species: Indian leopard, common kingfisher, Indian peafowl
caption:
A leopard in Uttarakhand, a kingfisher on its perch and a peacock dancing in Hyderabad.

India is the only country where wild lions, tigers and leopards all still live: the lions survive only in and around Gir in Gujarat.

Source: IUCN Red List, Panthera leo assessment.

Which one would you stop for? Tell us in the comments.
alt_text: Three short clips: a leopard walking through grass, a kingfisher turning its head, a peacock fanning its train, with the words India, unfiltered.
